status: Static partial contract with bounded runtime corroboration of all 53 descriptor mappings and the tested 3D bulk-replacement paths; complete mesh lifecycle remains unresolved.
method: Parse descriptor registration calls from saved REA/Ghidra constructor pseudocode, cross-check registration counts/order and allocation sizes, bind constructors to retained vtable bytes, and read saved allocation/free helpers. No target execution or provider query in this pass.
offset_convention: All offsets are bytes in the reference Windows x64 executable. These offsets and recovered class names are evidence labels, not a proposed portable C++ layout or established scientific terminology.

checks: Each parsed constructor call is followed by registration of the same local descriptor variable.
Each descriptor constructor has a matching recovered vtable name in its pseudocode.
The most recent allocation call establishes descriptor size 0x38 or 0x40 for each constructor branch.
IDs and pointer-slot offsets are unique within each container.
Node slots are contiguous from +0x10 through +0xe8; element state slots from +0x20 through +0xe0.
Allocation function is decoded from the complete third eight-byte vtable slot and agrees with the retained slot list.
limits: These checks validate the saved decompiler representation and table linkage; they are not independent runtime allocation observations.
Null descriptor registration is present after allocation failure branches. Failure behavior is not characterized or claimed safe.

fields.role: bound container slot updated to expose storage data
owner element container for STS/TEPS/DAMAG/CURRNT classes

state_updates: 0x140300f30 shifts current count +0x10 to previous +0x1c, then writes new count.
0x140300f90 shifts +0x14 to +0x20, then writes new component count.
0x140300ff0 shifts +0x18 to +0x24, then writes new multiplicity.

Constructor/reset calls 0x140300ec0 with 0, node constructor calls it with 1 and element constructor with 2. Setter storage offset and broader meaning are not established by the selected saved functions.
limits: Eight-byte elements are established by storage copy/resize paths. Individual physical meanings and units remain unassigned.
Recovered class abbreviations are retained verbatim and are not expanded into scientific names.

facts: Initializer first writes 1 to every entry, then applies dimension, controls and conditional feature overrides.
Dimension and later state changes can alter components. The registration map alone does not determine array size.
IDs 0,18..23 and61 are used by direct buffers outside the state-variable descriptor list.
limits: Full control-predicate semantics and every configuration of this component table remain unresolved.

descriptor_iteration: Allocation invoked indirectly through descriptor vtable+0x10 with requested count, component-table pointer and selector.
facts: Selected descriptors update count and component count before resize.
Ordinary bulk selector -1 includes all ordinary node/element descriptors but excludes StateVarNodePost descriptors.
Selector -2 can allocate direct buffers but fails every positive-ID descriptor selection condition; this is not synonymous with selector -1.
Count <= 0 bypasses both node/element outer allocation functions. Existing buffers are only cleared if the caller executes a free path.
Resize body executes only when requested product differs from existing storage element count.
It copies the old storage to temporary memory, calls 0x14019a740 with new size and an eight-byte zero fill value, then updates the bound pointer slot.
If the preserve argument is nonzero, the shown overlap loops use old/new item and component counts; no explicit third-multiplicity loop appears.
All mapped allocation overrides call this helper with preserve=0.
Return value is true only when the shown resize body executes. MATAXI default writes are conditional on this return value.
No-size-change skips the body, so preserve=0 does not itself clear existing same-size data. Ordinary mesh replacement clears storage first through separate free wrappers.
limits: 0x14019a740 routes shrinking to erase and growth to insert helpers; the full storage insertion/capacity implementation is not established by the selected evidence.
A zero fill argument does not prove that retained prefixes are zeroed on every direct resize; replacement free-before-resize is a separate fact.
Arithmetic is decompiled signed-int multiplication; overflow/allocation failure behavior is not validated.

special_allocators.default: If resize occurred and components[state_id] == 9, writes IEEE-754 1.0 bit pattern at indices item*9 + 0, +4 and +8. Other values follow underlying storage behavior.

special_allocators.extra_multiplicity: No special multiplicity update in this override; ordinary count/components/resize sequence despite owner pointer stored by constructor.

rules: If element_container+0xf0 owner is null, return 1.
Otherwise, if container dimension is not 3, return 4.
Otherwise, return 8 if container+0xec == 8; return 1 in other cases.
multiplicity_rule.qualification: This supplies extra storage multiplicity. Its integration-point/physical interpretation is not established here.

node.role: coordinate buffer established by importer evidence
node.allocate_when: count > 0, selector in {0,-2,-1}, existing pointer null

node.role: freed and nulled by node free routine; allocation path not established here

element.role: connectivity buffer established by importer evidence
freed and nulled by element free routine; allocation path not established here

metadata: Node bulk direct allocation stores count at container+0x12c.
Element bulk direct allocation stores element count at container+0xe8 and supplied connectivity width at +0xec.
Object-level element wrapper usually supplies object+0x894; a separate conditional path supplies 4. Predicate semantics remain unresolved.

free_and_ownership.container_descriptor_free: 0x140329dc0 loops all descriptors and invokes 0x140300e30 directly, including post-only descriptors.
descriptor_free: 0x140300e30 sets current item count to zero through history-shifting setter.
Clears backing storage through 0x1402568b0, then nulls the bound container pointer if binding exists.
Component count and multiplicity are not reset by this free function.
backing_storage: When backing record reference count > 1, 0x1400051a0 decrements it and substitutes a new 0x20-byte record copied by 0x1400033f0.
0x140256900 then frees backing-record+8 and zeroes pointers +8,+0x10,+0x18.
0x1400033f0 initializes reference count 1 and copies existing eight-byte elements into separate storage, or nulls all three pointers when the computed count is below one.
limits: These functions establish reference-count-aware detachment before clearing, not every copy/assignment/destructor path.
Descriptor registration/removal and complete object destruction still require separate recovery.

facts: Stores object node count at +0x880.
0x140162ff0 calls node free before bulk selector -1 allocation.
When component table exists, fills object+0x8e0 buffer (node state ID 8) for node_count*components[8] entries with 20.0 if 0x140235c10 returns 1, otherwise 68.0.
mesh_replacement_defaults.meaning: Numeric behavior established; scientific field name and unit predicate semantics are not assigned here.

facts: Stores object element count at +0x884.
0x140163090 calls element free before allocation.
If object+0x3980 > 0, fills direct buffer object+0x9f8 for count*components[61] integers with that value.
Fills state ID 44 at object+0xa30 for count*components[44] entries with 1.0.
Fills state ID 45 at object+0xa38 for count*components[45] entries with 0.0. The shown fill length does not multiply by the extra multiplicity; remaining storage depends on the allocation path.
mesh_replacement_defaults.meaning: Do not infer domain labels from these defaults alone.

remaining_questions: Extend the validated descriptor IDs, slots, shapes and pointer relationships beyond the tested default 3D replacement paths.
Validate post-only exclusion and targeted allocation on the actual caller paths.
Recover complete backing-storage resize/insertion semantics and all ownership aliases.
Recover component-table feature predicates and configuration-dependent multiplicity branches.
Recover derived geometry and full reset/destruction behavior before declaring the mesh lifecycle complete.
Treat unsafe negative counts, overflow, malformed connectivity and allocation failures as unresolved unless separately characterized.

observations: Two process runs contain seven imports, twenty object snapshots and 1060 descriptor observations.
All 28 node and 25 element descriptor IDs, object-relative slots and vtable RVAs match the static map.
Shape/history values, count*width*multiplicity storage lengths, descriptor identity and bound/storage pointer equality were checked.
Post-only IDs30..33 remain unallocated during these bulk replacements; all observed extra multiplicities remain1.
Repeated replacement and counts4/1 ->5/2 ->4/1 are observed. Node descriptor8 receives20 and element descriptor44 receives1; other captured descriptor values remain0.
Truncated-coordinate import status2 preserves existing connectivity while replacing coordinates and their dependent arrays.
limits: No 2D or alternate-unit fixture, targeted post-only allocation, nonunit extra multiplicity, nine-component MATAXI initialization, shared-storage detachment, overflow or allocation failure was exercised.
The probe captures allocation wrapper returns and import returns, not every intermediate write or complete process memory.
The verifier validates retained evidence and fixtures; replacement equivalence is a separate step.
